paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.35% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.10%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.59%). Brent crude changed -4.59% to 110.03. Gold changed -0.17% to 4,044.8. Bitcoin changed -1.39% to 80,137.9609. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.045%, a relative move of +1.04%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+12.51%) and Santander (-6.26%) moved the most.
